text_block_list.text:
It's here! It's finally here! The Arima
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
All right! Make sure you keep your eyes
on me,
Trainer. In this race, I'll—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Looks like we're facin' off again this
year.
Are you ready to eat my dust?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hm... I've got no idea what you're
yammerin'
about, Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Last year I told you you were
gonna eat my
dust, so I used that as a
springboard—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You should know me well enough by
now. If it's a
fight with me you wish for...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Do it on the track, not with your words.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Then let's go—you and me. At the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Heh... You've got quite the look in your
eye.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is staring at Triple
Crown
champion Нарита Брайан and the
"Queen of the
Amazons" Хиши Амадзон.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer! I kinda zoned out there!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: They sure do leave an impression, don't they?

text_block_list.text:
Hey, cut it out! You can't say that! I'm
not gonna
lose!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You're not allowed to look at anyone
but me
during the race! Got it?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
